findings.message: The comma after “कतार में” makes the label slightly awkward.
findings.suggested: Use “कतार में भेजें, फिर दिशा दें”.
findings.disposition: recorded, not churned: minor/nit only; no blocker or major

findings.message: “Enter से कतार, फिर दिशा” is too elliptical: “दिशा” alone does not clearly express the steering action.
findings.suggested: Use “Enter कतार में भेजता है, फिर दिशा देता है · Esc रोकता है”.
findings.disposition: recorded, not churned: minor/nit only; no blocker or major

findings.message: “आपकी दिशा” can sound like an instruction or physical direction rather than the pending steer message.
findings.suggested: Use “दिशा दी जा रही है — आपके दिशा-संदेश के साथ जाएगा”.
findings.disposition: recorded, not churned: minor/nit only; no blocker or major

notes: Meaning, register, key names, punctuation, product terminology, and empty placeholder sets are otherwise consistent; no BLOCKER or MAJOR findings.
